messages:
anna: Heads-up — farm noticed a perf regression on nightly serving after the KV compaction tweak. p50 latency up ~7% for 8k token chats, and GPU mem peaks higher causing occasional OOMs. Anyone seen this?

sam: yep saw the spike in dashboard. flame shows a big hotspot in kernel_select::choose_launch when seq_len>1024. feels like we’re picking a heavier kernel path more often.

mike: allocator fragmentation possibility. compaction changed block reuse timing, could be exposing small-block churn. did you see more small allocations in the trace?

anna: pasted a short trace from the job below:

```
GPU mem usage (sample):
  t=0s  used=11.3GB
  t=20s used=12.8GB (kv-compact start)
  t=45s used=13.9GB 
  peak=14.7GB at t=62s (oom on some hosts)
  backtrace: runtime::kv_compact -> blockmgr::evict -> kernel_select::choose_launch
```

ops-ci-bot: deploy r1227 rolled back to r1225 (auto), reason: serve OOM alert (threshold breach). :warning:

sam: interesting — kernel selection change + allocation graph -> more medium-sized buffers live concurrently. that increases working set and forces fallback kernels with worse memory footprint.

mike: two quick mitigations we can try: 1) lower default workspace_max (from 1.0 -> 0.8) for models with long context; 2) change allocator to prefer reusing medium blocks (>=64KB) over splitting small ones.

luis: I'll run a memfrag profile with the new tracepoints I added last week (alloc/free tagged with block_bucket). should help show whether reuse windows are missing.

anna: can someone draft an A/B config for the perf cluster? target: reduce p50 reg while avoiding latency tail regressions.

mike: quick config suggestion to test (will push to staging):

```yaml
runtime:
  workspace_max_fraction: 0.8
  allocator:
    medium_reuse_threshold: 65536  # prefer reuse for >=64KB
    eager_compact_delay_ms: 2000  # wait before compact to let reuse win
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048  # avoid huge single-batch kernels for long chats
```

sam: also add a kernel-selection safeguard: if seq_len>2048 and estimated_live_mem>12GB, force low-memory kernel variant. simple policy for experiments.

luis: running the memfrag profiler now on a replicated job. ETA ~30m. will post flame/png.

anna: thanks — if the profiler shows reuse misses, we should try bumping eager_compact_delay first (less risky) and rerun performance regression tests.

mike: agree. also adding a unit/regression test: synthetic long-chat workload with chunked KV patterns to detect future regressions.

sam: tagging this for postmortem if rollback persists. adding checklist: perf dashboard diff, memfrag flame, kernel-choice histogram, KV compaction timeline.

luis: profiler complete — attachment: memfrag_flame_1758009999.png (uploaded). early look: many medium blocks freed right before compaction window; reuse latency ~300ms.

anna: perfect — will try the config on staging and run nightly benchmark. assigning @mike to push config, @sam to add regression test, @luis to confirm profiler annotations. :thumbsup:
